date.as_written: śrīman nepālika samvatsara 406 mārgaśīṛṣaktaghna . ekādaśyāṃ tithau | śaniścaravāsare | svāti nakṣatre | śobhana yoge

notes: The colophon gives NS 406 (Mārgaśīrṣa → c. Nov/Dec 1285 CE), which fits the reign of Anantamalla (c. 1274–1310). The catalogue's 'VS 1980' (1923 CE) conflicts with this. The manuscript may be a modern copy that reproduces the colophon of an NS 406 exemplar, in which case the persons and date belong to the exemplar. The pakṣa word 'ṣaktaghna' is corrupt and cannot be read safely. 'Paramasevācārya' is doubtful as a personal name: it may be an epithet/title or a corruption, perhaps of Paramaśiva.
